final_draft.answer: Two. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need two approving reviews before they can be merged. The rule applies to administrators as well.
final_draft.note: This is a direct match to an approved answer (control CC8.1, owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-16). The approved answer covers only the default branch of harborlight/app. It doesn't say whether other repositories follow the same two-review rule, so please check this before sending if the customer means all repositories.

arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:e6e4adc0-5fa7-4501-acbf-f5f83f77a: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:7a42ece0-0249-45d2-a1b7-50893635c: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:79156597-3838-4735-a56a-921af5bd5: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:4a434245-ec23-4d83-8e71-46070d6e0: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:f5f8b509-f22f-4afc-8652-f0181df35: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
